t: This is St Chad's, a Grade I listed Anglican church on Dunloe Street in Haggerston. It was designed by James Brooks and completed in 1869 as part of the Haggerston Church Scheme. Brooks was an influential Gothic Revival architect, known for landmark churches in the East End, and won the Royal Gold Medal in 1895. The church is named for Chad, a seventh-century Anglo-Saxon monk and bishop later known as a saint. It has long been associated with High Church liturgy and Anglo-Catholicism.
